description: Credit card export (Type column, debits positive) with a quoted preamble row, a Netflix monthly subscription, a refund pair, six interleaved one-off merchants, and a McDonald's habit written half the time as "MCDONALD'S" (apostrophe) and half as "MCDONALDS"/"Mcdonalds" (no apostrophe) across three months, to measure whether merchant-stem grouping survives an apostrophe. Was a known gap (OB-2 baseline): normalizeMerchant() split the apostrophe spelling into its own 'mcdonald' stem, undercounting the merchant's true frequency by 6/14 (~43%). Fixed in OB-3: apostrophes (straight, curly, modifier-letter) are stripped before the tokenizer, so both spellings stem to 'mcdonalds' and cluster together.
